verdict.rationale: Ramp's product page explicitly claims auto top-up from linked checking accounts with target-balance automation and low-balance alerts, which covers each element of the story. Supporting claims include automated bank transfers ("80% of bank transfers automated") and a Banking API that reads account balances and daily balance history. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of top-up configuration (thresholds, timing, which account pairs are supported), detail on how and where low-balance alerts are delivered, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing one-liners.
